rv.q: Subtle, highly skilled and richly rewarding.
It is very moving and very fine.
Despite green’s ability to write dialogue that is pointed and perceptive, I quickly got tired of going around in circles.
Another triumph for The Royal Court- another fantastically written piece executed to perfection.

cn.t: Debbie Tucker Green's poetic dissection of love earns strong praise for its fierce writing and inventive staging—mostly. One dissenting voice keeps this from unanimous acclaim, but the raw, unromantic emotional honesty lands hard for most critics.
